name: lid-awake
title: Lid Awake
description: Keep your Mac awake with the lid closed, with auto-off timers and a low battery cutoff.
author: o101k

preferences.name: batteryThreshold
preferences.title: Low Battery Cutoff
preferences.description: Turn off automatically when running on battery below this level

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Set up Lid Awake
commands.description: Install or remove the passwordless rule that lets Lid Awake toggle sleep

commands.name: start
commands.title: Keep Awake with Lid Closed
commands.subtitle: Lid Awake
commands.description: Pick how long to keep the Mac awake with the lid closed

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Allow Sleep
commands.subtitle: Lid Awake
commands.description: Turn Lid Awake off and let the Mac sleep normally

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Lid Awake
commands.description: Turn Lid Awake on for the default duration, or off

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Lid Awake Menu Bar
commands.description: Shows Lid Awake status and turns it off when the timer ends, the battery is low, or after a restart

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
